text: Official CLI brings 1Password to the terminal and integrates with the desktop app to sign in with Touch ID, Windows Hello, or other system auth
quote: 1Password CLI brings 1Password to your terminal. Learn how to install the CLI, then integrate it with your 1Password app and sign in with Touch ID, Windows Hello, or another system authentication option.

text: CLI uses a noun-verb command structure that groups commands by topic
quote: 1Password CLI uses a noun-verb command structure that groups commands by topic rather than by operation.

text: CLI can list the names and values of secrets in a 1Password Environment
quote: This release adds `op environment secret list`, which lists the name and value of each secret in a 1Password Environment.

text: Credential Broker gives CI/CD and other machine workflows short-lived access to secrets without managing service account tokens
quote: Use the 1Password Credential Broker to give CI/CD and other machine workflows short-lived access to secrets, without managing service account tokens.

text: Connect Servers expose items and vaults to company apps and cloud infrastructure through a private REST API
quote: 1Password Connect Servers allow you to securely access your 1Password items and vaults in your company's apps and cloud infrastructure using a private REST API.

text: Service Accounts automate secrets management in apps and infrastructure without deploying extra services
quote: 1Password Service Accounts help automate secrets management in your applications and infrastructure without the need to deploy additional services.

text: Service accounts are scoped to chosen vaults and Environments, and to specific allowed actions
quote: You control which vaults and Environments are accessible and which actions the service account can perform.

text: Verifies AI agents and machine workloads at runtime and delivers only the credentials each one is authorized to receive
quote: Verify AI agents and machine workloads at runtime, then deliver only the credentials each is authorized to receive.

text: Events API retrieves Business account activity so it can be sent to a SIEM
quote: The 1Password Events API allows you to retrieve information about activity in your 1Password Business account and send it to your security information and event management (SIEM) system.

text: Load secrets into code with secret references, or read environment variables from 1Password Environments
quote: Secure your applications: Load secrets into your code with secret references or read environment variables from 1Password Environments.

text: Items in a 1Password account can be managed programmatically
quote: Automate item management: Programmatically manage items in your 1Password account.

text: Official SDKs for Go, JavaScript, and Python let you build integrations that interact with 1Password programmatically
quote: 1Password SDKs allow you to build integrations that programmatically interact with 1Password using Go, JavaScript, or Python.

text: Official MCP server lets clients such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Kiro manage 1Password Environments
quote: The 1Password Environments MCP Server lets MCP clients such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Kiro securely manage your 1Password Environments.

text: MCP server sees only the names of secrets and Environments and never returns the actual secret values
quote: The server can only see the names of your secrets and Environments, and never returns the actual secret values stored in your Environments, which stay safe in 1Password.

text: Developers can ask ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, or similar web chats questions about 1Password developer tools
quote: Use ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, or similar web chat to ask questions about 1Password developer tools.

text: Events API is published as a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.0 spec (version 1.4.1)
quote: 1Password publishes the Events API as a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document (semver 1.4.1), linked from the Events API reference ("This API reference documents the latest version of the 1Password Events API specifications (1.4.1)"), which r

text: Connect Server API ships a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.2 spec (version 1.8.1)
quote: The 1Password Connect Server API likewise ships a downloadable OpenAPI document (3.0.2, version 1.8.1), linked from the Connect API reference as the specification file. The specs cover the Events and Connect surfaces; the Service Accounts/C

text: Events and Connect API references include an interactive 'Try it' playground with generated cURL samples
quote: The Events API and Connect API references run the Mintlify interactive playground ("Try it" renders next to the endpoint, e.g. POST /api/v2/auditevents, with generated cURL samples). The CLI/SDK docs are prose and code only.

text: Events API uses URL-path versioning, keeps V1 endpoints fully supported alongside V2, and has a dedicated changelog
quote: The Events API documents URL-path versioning with a continued-support commitment: "The Events API supports both V1 and V2 endpoints... V1 endpoints remain fully supported for existing integrations that don't require the additional MSP accou

text: SSH Agent authenticates Git and SSH workflows and acts as the key provider for existing SSH clients
quote: The SSH agent works with your existing SSH clients and acts as their key provider.

text: 1Password serves as the single source of truth for storing all your SSH keys
quote: Introducing 1Password for SSH & Git, the single source of truth for all your SSH keys.

text: Autofills SSH public keys in the browser for Git and other cloud platforms
quote: Autofill public keys in your browser for Git and other cloud platforms.

text: Automatically configures Git commit signing with SSH from the 1Password app
quote: Automatically configure Git commit signing with SSH from the 1Password app.

text: Creates, saves, and manages passkeys, and signs in to websites and apps with them from the browser extension
quote: you can now create, manage, and sign in with passkeys on a growing number of websites and apps directly from the 1Password browser extension

text: Watchtower flags existing logins that could be upgraded to use a passkey
quote: opening Watchtower in 1Password, which now flags all of your existing logins that could be updated with a passkey

text: Watchtower alerts you to breaches, weak passwords, duplicate items, and other security problems in saved items
quote: Watchtower tells you about breaches, weak passwords, duplicate items, and other security problems with the items you have saved in 1Password.

text: Exports your information from the 1Password apps so you can move it to a different app
quote: You can export your information from the 1Password apps if you want to move it to a different app.

text: Imports data from many browsers and applications, including apps that export CSV files
quote: You can import data into 1Password from many different browsers and applications, including applications that export data in the comma-separated values (CSV) file format

text: On iOS/iPadOS 26 or later, imports data directly from apps that support the Credential Exchange standard
quote: If you use 1Password on iOS or iPadOS 26 or later, you can import data directly from apps that support the Credential Exchange standard.

text: Apple Watch app gives quick lookup of passwords, card numbers and PINs, one-time passwords, bank details, Wi-Fi QR codes, and notes
quote: Use 1Password on your Apple Watch to quickly look up information: credit card numbers and PINs, one-time passwords, bank account details, passport numbers, Wi-Fi QR codes, secure notes

text: Stores one-time passwords for two-step verification and gives quick access to them
quote: Learn how to use 1Password to store and quickly access your one-time passwords when you turn on two-step verification for a website.

text: Signs you in to sites, suggests passwords, and finds items without leaving the browser
quote: 1Password lets you easily sign in to sites, use suggested passwords, and find what you need – all without leaving your browser.

text: Generates and remembers strong, unique passwords
quote: 1Password generates and memorizes secure passwords like "EnM4K=b):k@U*Nr9Y" so you don't have to.

text: Automatically offers to save your login
quote: 1Password will automatically offer to save your login.

text: Everything in your account is always end-to-end encrypted
quote: Everything in your 1Password account is always end-to-end encrypted.

text: Securely shares logins, secrets, credit cards, Wi-Fi codes, and other sensitive data with automatic expirations
quote: Securely share logins, secrets, credit cards, Wi-Fi codes and other sensitive data with automatic expirations.

text: Ensures only secure, known devices can access your company's apps
quote: Make sure only secure, known devices can access your company's apps.
